evals.name: current-session
evals.prompt: このセッション、fork も含めて何が動いたのか tree で見せて
evals.expected_output: A tree of the current session: user turns as top-level nodes, subagents nested beneath the turn that spawned them, the one fork marked distinctly, each node one line with an outcome.
assertions: Renders an actual indented tree (box-drawing or equivalent), not a flat list or prose
Identifies the fork and marks it distinctly from ordinary subagents
Reports the agent count as 45 (or states a count consistent with the session)
Shows nesting depth: at least one agent appears as a child of another agent, not just of a user turn
Each agent node carries an outcome, not only the task it was given
Groups agents under the user turn that caused them

evals.name: project-wide
evals.prompt: このプロジェクトで今までどんなセッションがあった？ざっと知りたい
evals.expected_output: An index of all sessions in the project with titles, dates, branch and agent counts — not a full map of every session — followed by an offer to expand one.
assertions: Lists multiple sessions (project-level view), not just the current one
Includes per-session metadata such as date, title, branch, or agent count
Does NOT dump a full tree for every session
Offers to drill into a specific session

evals.name: agent-tracing
evals.prompt: 収益化レポートのとき、市場調査って何個のエージェントが動いたんだっけ？どれが何を出したか知りたい
evals.expected_output: The market-research branch specifically: the parent research agent plus its nested children, each with what it returned. Should scope to the relevant subtree rather than dumping all 45 agents.
assertions: Scopes to the market-research branch rather than listing all 45 agents
Shows the nested children spawned by the market research agent
States what each agent actually returned, not just its assignment
